map.基于Gorelick临床体征评分，量化评估儿童脱水程度，计算补液方案: Quantify pediatric dehydration by Gorelick clinical-sign score and compute a rehydration plan
map.临床体征评估（Gorelick标准，勾选存在的体征）: Clinical-sign assessment (Gorelick criteria, check present signs)
map.皮肤弹性差、眼窝凹陷、尿少: Poor skin turgor, sunken eyes, oliguria
map.提示：Gorelick评分包含10项体征，每项1分。≥3分=中度脱水(敏感性74: Note: the Gorelick score has 10 signs, 1 point each. ≥3 = moderate dehydration (sensitivity 74%, specificity 86%), ≥7 = severe. Rehydration principle: replace fast then slow, salt before sugar, add potassium once urine appears. Moderate-severe dehydration needs prompt medical care. This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.Gorelick 4 分→缺失约 7.5%：累计丢失=10×0.075=750: Gorelick 4 points -> loss ~7.5%: cumulative loss = 10×0.075 = 750 mL, needs replenishment.
map.适用于 1 月–5 岁腹泻患儿快速分度，结合体重变化更准。: For rapid staging of diarrheal children aged 1 month-5 years; combined with weight change is more accurate.
map.先补累计丢失、再给维持量(100mL/kg 前 10kg)，口服不耐受则静脉。: First replace cumulative loss, then give maintenance (100 mL/kg for first 10 kg); IV if oral not tolerated.
map.关于「脱水(体液丢失)评估器」: About the Dehydration (Body Fluid Loss) Assessor
map.儿童脱水(体液丢失)评估器，基于Gorelick标准量化评估脱水严重程度，计算液: The pediatric dehydration (fluid-loss) assessor quantifies severity by Gorelick criteria and computes fluid requirement and rehydration plan. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
